issues: Covers rose by 16 (0.82%) to 1,949 week on week and spend per head rose by £0.65 (3.37%) to £20.49.
Sales were £41,212.79, up £1,859.92 (4.72%) week on week and £1,212.79 (3.03%) above the £40,000 target.
Wage cost was 24% and food cost 25.92%, and Ziang Lin described Southampton as potentially the strongest site in South England.
Ziang Lin will visit on Friday and Saturday to help bring labour down to 22%, and the site is cross training staff to reduce reliance on dedicated bartenders.
The aggregated weekly rating was 4.94 across 49 reviews; the report records 40 five star, 3 four star and one 1 star review.
The 1 star review said the steak was chewy, the broth tasted strongly of MSG and was too salty, the sushi rice was warm and the drinks tasted artificial.
Chris is responsible for Google reviews and June for loyalty app sign ups.
Customers were initially told to sign up to the app at the start of their visit rather than after paying, and sign up rewards are taking between two minutes and two hours to process.
A minimum target of 100 app sign ups a week has been set, which may rise to 200 a week next month.
Recurring drinks ordering errors (orange syrup) mean drinks ordering is being moved to another team member.
Ziang Lin stressed that assistant general managers must be able to step up to GM within three to six months so sites do not struggle during absences.
The Go Southampton B2B link with 15 organisations launches officially on Thursday, with campus meetings at Southampton Crossings and MTM digital platform meetings on 14, 22 and 24 October.
Kitchen lead Justyna has been on holiday since 01/10 and ordered extra stock beforehand, causing a slight food cost spike; stock levels are strong with no shortages.
Full timers (Jenny and Pantan) are being prioritised over part timers with rigid availability.
Several tickets came through with impossible allergen requests, such as a gluten allergy ordering black garlic tonkotsu, so FOH needs more allergen training rather than relying on the kitchen.
The recurring electrical tripping has worsened, and the panel could no longer be reset when all kitchen equipment ran at once.
Walk-in freezer repairs are awaiting confirmed dates, and Ross has fixed the hand wash tap pressure.
No audit was done this week.
Sammy has resigned.
Half term is the next upcoming event, and the areas for improvement are labour cost (through cross training) and increasing Google reviews.
